basis: LAUNCHER3-COMPILE adapter binding (Release-owned): the host inputs scripts/launcher3-compile.py needs to compile Launcher3QuickStepLib against OS Product's input contract os/compile-contracts/launcher3-quickstep-lib.json (schema 3). branch selects verifyIntegrated (the copy is exactly the final images), verifyBaseApplyCandidate (the copy is exactly the base images of the integrating bundle a bound rose-integration-bundle-report v1 matches to base.bundleContent; the candidate delta is then applied in the copy only) or reconstruct (refused: no approved genuine-Git-object source). The selected branch is verifyBaseApplyCandidate: no patcher registers the candidate delta (the contract's candidatePatches), so no integrated tree is at the final images, and a tree integrated by the current patcher may be completed only through all four of its conditions (branches.otherwise). Every host fact is null until it is verified and committed: sourceTree (the tree byte-copied into the per-run root), lunch (only frankel-cur-user, the target of os/compile-contracts/frankel-lunch-inputs.json, whose lunch inputs are checked on the copy, definitions.lunch; it needs the retained vendor/google_devices/frankel), policyReceipt (the integrating run's own --background-policy file, whose sha256 the config.xml check binds), bundleReport (a rose-integration-bundle-report v1 in base.bundleReport's form from its stated producer, with its sha256; a bare bundleContent is refused; its run names the reviewed run-association document os/build-only/launcher3-bundle-run.json by path and the sha256 of its committed bytes, which base.bundleReport.values binds run.bindingSha256 and the report's run fields to), reconstructSource and adevtoolGit (null, or public-fetch: the pinned adevtool commit fetched from the pinned manifest's public source into the copy, admitted only when the pinned lunch-input contract lists that class; binding it needs its own runtime approval). No receipt or report path may be inside the source tree or a launcher3-compile run root. While any input of the selected branch is null the hosted check exits 4 before the controller. The reference display address and locked-control inputs are derived from os/release-pipeline/frankel.json applyArgs, not stated here. Nothing here was read from or run on any host.
